method: All paths relative to android/jadx-out/sources. (1) Property catalogue: parse p056e8/r.java (Kotlin sealed class Property.kt) - every `class X extends b|c|T|AbstractC2064g0|AbstractC2080v` with its `super(<id>)` (CipherSuite/MeshAddress constants resolved: TLS_DHE_DSS_WITH_AES_256_CBC_SHA256=0x6A, TLS_DH_anon_WITH_AES_256_CBC_SHA256=0x6D, TLS_ECDH_ECDSA_WITH_NULL_SHA=0xC001, _RC4_128_SHA=0xC002, _3DES_EDE_CBC_SHA=0xC003, START_GROUP_ADDRESS=0xC000) and `toString()` name; 94 classes = 5 SIG (r.b.*), 87 LBC (r.c.*), 2 dynamic LED (r.c.T.a/b, ids from T.e(): base 0xA001/0xA002 + 3k, k=0..5) - cross-checked against the sealed lists in de/jung/junghome/app/ui/project/shareViaFile/f.java cases 25 (SIG) and 26 (LBC). (2) For each singleton field (grep `f47[0-9]+[a-z]? = new` in r.java) grep -rlw the field name to find MessageBuilders (p234v7, p245w7, p254x7, p266y7, B7, C7, J7); model = builder status opcode `this.fNNNb = <int>` (12920581 LBC Admin, 13313797 LBC Manufacturer, 13707013 LBC User, 70 SIG Manufacturer, 74 SIG Admin, 82 Sensor) plus G7.a-f imports, access from `UserAccess.*`, value size from `W.a(n)`/put*. (3) Resolvers: grep `e8\.r\.[bc]\.[A-Za-z0-9.]+\.class` in de/jung/junghome/data/mesh/resolver -> property class, capability via `instanceof`, decode via dispatcher case (`new C1901b0(n,`, `new ...gateway.detail.z(n,`, `new e2(n,`, `new A0(`, threshold/devices/d.java; `throw null` = TODO). (4) Capability -> UI: grep the capability class in de/jung/junghome/app (deviceParameter/providers/*Parameter$1.java names give the parameter). (5) Sensor/SIG ids: grep `DeviceProperty\.[A-Z_]+` outside no/nordicsemi (C2347a, C2349b, P0, C2364i0, L0, F7/b, F7/c, SensorSettingsViewModel o() and t()), resolve numbers in no/nordicsemi/android/mesh/sensorutils/DeviceProperty.java. (6) Second sweep: grep `new (GenericPropertyGet|GenericAdminPropertySet|GenericManufacturerPropertySet|GenericUserPropertySet)(`, `r\.a\.a(` dynamic lookups (JungMeshApiImpl readProperty/q1, KeySet target p085h8/e, LED builders p266y7), model-id constants 86446097/98/99/101 and 4113/4114/4115/4352, and res/values/strings.xml `device_parameter_*_title` keys mapped back to providers (floor-temperature string has no Java user; night-mode string = LED mode byte). Ids: prop:0xNNNN = LBC vendor property id; prop:sig:0xNNNN = SIG Generic property; prop:sensor:0xNNNN = SIG sensor property; prop:model:<model id hex, vendor as 0xCCCCMMMM>; prop:meta:<lowercased class/method name>. Firmware-only ids (not in the APK) are deliberately excluded. Verification sweep (different angle, for reruns): (a) every class 'compiled from: *MessageBuilder.kt' outside no/ mapped to the r.b/r.c singleton or DeviceProperty it references (128 builders, no property outside this list); (b) every 'compiled from: *Capability.kt' name not mentioned in the items, each checked for a property id (none: they are SIG/config/scheduler capabilities); (c) every 'new (Generic*Propert*|Sensor(Get|Descriptor|Cadence|Setting|Settings))(' outside no/; (d) the resolver base classes AbstractC1972z0 (LBC) and AbstractC1929k1 (SIG) and their subclasses; (e) model-id literals 8644609x/864461xx and 4113-4116/4352/4353 in de/, E7/, P7/ (adds prop:model:0x1101); (f) every res/values/strings.xml device_parameter_* key not quoted in an item, resolved to its R.string user (hotel, night light, presence simulation, floor temperature, time role, wind alarm, operation lock and sync rocker strings have no Java user; sensor_values_for_gateway = Sensor Server publication, not a property); (g) the configuration interactors (domain/interactors/configuration/*.java 'CommunicateWithDevice.Params(') for commissioning-time property writes (ConfigureDetector: 0x6021 = 50, 0x100B = true, 0x1007 = 120 s); (h) on-air property ids in captures-inventory.json not in this inventory (0x000D, 0x000E, 0x0072, 0x5012-0x5014 SIG/LBC) are firmware-only and live in inventory-air.json.

items.title: LBC 0x0001 DeviceKeyLock / device key configuration (RW)
items.details: name=DeviceKeyLockProperty; capability=DeviceKeyConfigurationCapability; LBC Admin (vendor 0x0527:0x1011): Get opcode 0xC52702 (337666, G7.a) `[id u16 LE]`, Set 0xC52703 (337667, G7.b) `[id u16 LE][userAccess u8][value]`, Status 0xC52705 (12920581) `[id u16 LE][userAccess u8][value]`. Value uint16 LE bit-field of 5 flags. Encoder J8/C0541i.toByteArray: MSB-first writer 11 zero bits then isConfigurationLockActive, isKeyLockActive, isLocalDevicesLockActive, isFactoryResetWithTimeLimitActive, isLocalFactoryResetLockActive, then byte-reversed => bit0=LocalFactoryResetLock, bit1=FactoryResetWithTimeLimit, bit2=LocalDevicesLock, bit3=KeyLock, bit4=ConfigurationLock. Decoder (gateway/detail/z.java case 25) reads reversed bytes, skips 11 bits and assigns in field order a..e => bit4->LocalFactoryResetLock ... bit0->ConfigurationLock (mirrored vs encoder; app bug in one direction). UI: SharedDeviceParametersProvider deviceLockParameter/keyLockParameter/lockConfigurationParameter/lockFactoryResetParameter (strings device_parameter_lock_title, _key_lock_title, _configuration_lock_title, _lock_factory_reset_title, _local_devices_lock_title). Products: control switches/rockers, wall transmitters, sockets, detectors, RTR, mini actuators.

items.details: name=AstroSchedulerRegisterProperty; capability=AstroSchedulerRegisterCapability; LBC Admin (vendor 0x0527:0x1011): Get opcode 0xC52702 (337666, G7.a) `[id u16 LE]`, Set 0xC52703 (337667, G7.b) `[id u16 LE][userAccess u8][value]`, Status 0xC52705 (12920581) `[id u16 LE][userAccess u8][value]`. items.title: LBC property status parsing / id resolution
items.details: Accepted status opcodes 13707013/12920581/13313797; payload `[propId u16 LE][userAccess u8][value]`; empty value -> ignored (UtilsKt.k). Id -> class via r.a.a(): LED ranges first (T.b then T.a), then LBC sealed list (shareViaFile/f case 26) then SIG list (case 25), else UnknownProperty(id) (r.d). Resolver matched by property class equality, so duplicate ids resolve to the first list entry. Value handed to resolvers both as LE ByteBuffer and as BitReader over the byte-reversed value.

items.title: SIG Generic property status parsing (StatusMessageResolver)
items.details: Base of the five SIG property resolvers (U 0x0010, V 0x0011, X 0x001A, X1 0x006A, Y1 0x006D; compiled from StatusMessageResolver.kt): accepts any Nordic GenericPropertyStatus (Manufacturer 0x46 / Admin 0x4A / User 0x4E), drops it when the property value is empty (UtilsKt.k on getPropertyValue(), line 29), resolves the id through the same r.a.a() lookup as the LBC statuses (LED ranges, LBC list, SIG list, else UnknownProperty -> no resolver), passes the user-access byte on. So a status that carries [pid][access] but no value never changes a stored capability (energy, power-on time, version, manufacturer info). Found by the second-angle sweep: the resolver base classes (extends AbstractC1972z0 / AbstractC1929k1) rather than the property classes.

items.title: UnknownProperty fallback (r.d)
items.details: Any id not in the LED ranges, LBC list or SIG list becomes UnknownProperty(id); no resolver matches, so the status is dropped.

SensorGet(propertyId) with status 0x52 (82) for 0x004F and 0x0081; developer sensor-settings screen also uses SensorDescriptorGet (E0), SensorCadenceGet/Set (D0: cadence with StatusTriggerDelta.Percent(0,1)), SensorSettingsGet (I0), SensorSettingGet/Set (H0) on the ids of prop:sensor:* items.

items.title: Model SIG Sensor Setup Server 0x1101
items.details: SIG model 4353 (MeshModel.SensorSetupServer, mapped in E7/f). In the app's bind list P7/a (bound to the AppKey at configuration together with 0x1100). It is the server of the property-keyed setup messages the developer sensor-settings screen sends for the prop:sensor:* ids: Sensor Cadence Get/Set (D0, cadence with StatusTriggerDelta.Percent(0,1), fast-cadence divisor / min interval from the UI), Sensor Settings Get (I0) and Sensor Setting Get/Set (H0: sensor property id + setting property id taken from the Settings Status, value written raw). No production screen uses it.

items.title: Sensor 0x004D PRESENCE_DETECTED (debug sensor-settings list, detectors)
items.details: Nordic DeviceProperty.PRESENCE_DETECTED(77). Only appears as a string in SensorSettingsViewModel.t() for detector devices (AbstractC0915d); the name->id mapper o() has no case for it and returns -1, so the developer sensor-settings screen cannot actually address it. No builder/resolver.

items.title: Sensor 0x004F PRESENT_AMBIENT_TEMPERATURE (RTR actual temperature)
items.details: SIG Sensor Server 0x1100: SensorGet(PRESENT_AMBIENT_TEMPERATURE) builder C2349b, expected status opcode 0x52 (82, Sensor Status). Decoder F7/a default branch: raw LE signed integer x 0.5 (2^-1) degC, clamped to 5..30 for the UI, into d9.a (actual temperature). Read on app open/refresh (LoadStateForDevices) for the room thermostat pid 0x000A. Listed as the only sensor for RtrDevice in the debug sensor-settings screen, but o() does not map this name (-1). Read-only.

items.title: Sensor 0x0052 PRESENT_DEVICE_INPUT_POWER (debug sensor-settings only)
items.details: Nordic DeviceProperty(82). Listed in SensorSettingsViewModel.t() for measuring socket (r0), measure lamp (n0) and energy puck (b8.a); o() maps it to 0x0052 for SensorCadenceGet/Set (D0), SensorSettingsGet (I0), SensorSettingGet/Set (H0), SensorDescriptorGet (E0). Debug/developer screen only; no value decoder in app.

items.title: Sensor 0x0055 PRESENT_ILLUMINANCE (debug sensor-settings list, detectors)
items.details: Nordic DeviceProperty.PRESENT_ILLUMINANCE(85). Listed for detectors in SensorSettingsViewModel.t(), but o() returns -1 for it (unmapped). No builder/resolver.

items.title: Sensor 0x0057 PRESENT_INPUT_CURRENT (debug sensor-settings only)
items.details: Nordic DeviceProperty(87). Same handling as 0x0052: measuring devices, mapped by o() for cadence/settings/descriptor messages in the developer sensor-settings screen. No app decoder.

items.title: Sensor 0x005C PRESENT_OUTPUT_CURRENT (debug sensor-settings only)
items.details: Nordic DeviceProperty(92). Same handling as 0x0052 (measuring devices, developer sensor-settings screen). No app decoder.

items.title: Sensor 0x005D PRESENT_OUTPUT_VOLTAGE (debug sensor-settings only)
items.details: Nordic DeviceProperty(93). Same handling as 0x0052 (measuring devices, developer sensor-settings screen). No app decoder.

items.title: Sensor 0x0081 ACTIVE_POWER_LOAD_SIDE (live power, thresholds)
items.details: SIG Sensor Server: SensorGet(ACTIVE_POWER_LOAD_SIDE) builder C2347a, status 0x52. Decoder F7/a case 0: raw LE integer x 0.1 W into M8.a. Also the sensor property id embedded (u16 LE 0x0081) in TurnOn/TurnOffThreshold 0x5004/0x5005 values (L0). Listed first in the developer sensor-settings list for r0/n0/b8.a. Products: measuring socket 0x0003, energy puck 0x0010, measure lamp. Read-only.

items.title: SIG 0x0010 Device Hardware Revision (read-only)
items.details: name=ManufacturerHardwareRevisionProperty; capability=ManufacturerInfosCapability; SIG Generic Manufacturer Property Server 0x1012: GenericPropertyGet opcode 0x822B (33323), status 0x46 (70, Generic Manufacturer Property Status). Read-only (no Set builder). Raw bytes stored in ManufacturerInfosCapability (G8.a, together with 0x0011). Read at provisioning by RequestManufacturerInfos for every node (base Device). Numeric overlap with firmware LBC ids 0x0010/0x0011 (LPN_STATE_TIMEOUT/BAT_TEST_RAW_DATA) is irrelevant: different server.

items.title: SIG 0x0011 Device Manufacturer Name (read-only)
items.details: name=ManufacturerNameProperty; capability=ManufacturerInfosCapability; SIG Generic Manufacturer Property Server: GenericPropertyGet 0x822B, status 0x46. Read-only. Raw bytes (UTF-8 name) into G8.a. Read at provisioning (RequestManufacturerInfos), all products.

items.title: SIG 0x001A Device Software Revision (read-only, ASCII digits)
items.details: name=ManufacturerSoftwareVersionProperty; capability=ManufacturerInfosCapability; SIG Generic Manufacturer Property Server: GenericPropertyGet 0x822B, status 0x46. Read-only. Parsed as ASCII string, NULs removed, split into 2-char groups, leading '0' stripped, joined by '.' ("02020002" -> "2.2.0.2"). Stored in G8.b; used as node firmware version for gates: RtrHvacMode 0x120B needs >= 2.2.0.0, RtrTouchSensitivity 0x0012 needs >= 1.0.3.3 (resolver C1901b0 cases 17/23). All products.

items.title: SIG 0x006A Total Device Energy Use (read + reset)
items.details: name=TotalDeviceEnergyUse; capability=TotalEnergyUseCapability; SIG Generic Admin Property Server 0x1011: Get = GenericPropertyGet opcode 0x822D (33325), status 0x4A (74). Read: whole value as little-endian unsigned integer x1, app treats as Wh (/1000 -> kWh in ConfigurationConsumptionViewModel). Write (reset total consumption) = GenericAdminPropertySet(access=3, int32 LE of the new value, app sends 0). Capability TotalEnergyUseCapability (t8.b). Products: measuring socket pid 0x0003 (Y7.r0), measure lamp (n0) and energy puck pid 0x0010 (b8.a). UI: consumption screen + 'reset total consumption'.

items.title: SIG 0x006D Total Device Power On Time (read + reset)
items.details: name=TotalDevicePowerOnTime; capability=PowerOnTimeCapability; SIG Generic Admin Property Server: GenericPropertyGet 0x822D, status 0x4A. Read LE unsigned integer x1 (on-air: uint24 hours). Write = GenericAdminPropertySet(access=3, int32 LE) issued together with the energy reset. Capability PowerOnTimeCapability (t8.a). Products: measuring socket / energy devices. UI: consumption configuration screen.
